sentences.text: Keski-Suomen Laiturirakentajat Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-12 under the industry code 30110, building of civilian ships and floating structures.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-12, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-25.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, and the register confidence for the entry is low.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
